provenance: Actual Electron renderer from out/renderer of the checkout this script ran in; synthetic git, policy and prefs; no real agent calls
checks: the commit box shows the exact Assisted-by lines, labelled as only the sessions Wanigan started and recorded here since the last commit, unclipped
pressing Commit scans first: three findings listed as file:line, rule and masked line, nothing committed, and the way past is a button named Commit anyway
Commit anyway hands main the digest of exactly the findings shown, with the trailer lines the box displayed
a clean scan commits straight through, carrying no acknowledgement for main to accept
a scan that fails says the check did not run and commits nothing, rather than reading as clean
with the setting off the preview disappears after the next read, and nothing in the box claims attribution
when the lines cannot be worked out the box says so, and that a commit would be refused for the same reason
pressing Push scans the unpushed commits first, names the commit each finding came from, and offers Push anyway instead of the plain confirmation
Push anyway sends the digest of the findings that were shown
a clean push states what was read and that a clean result is not proof, and pushes without an acknowledgement
the ledger reads "Chain verified through 1,204 records · head signed", counts the 38 pre-chain records as unverified, and names the signing key
Verify now re-reads the chain; a break names the record, the tool and what kind of change it was, and counts only the records before it as verified
a chain that recomputes under a head it no longer matches is reported as a mismatch, not as verified
a check that fails reads "Not verified" with the reason, and nothing from the earlier success stays on screen
Commit attribution is off by default, says what an absent line does not mean, and turning it on writes assisted_by_trailers
